Crop guides: when to plant every Nigerian crop

Quick answer: Most Nigerian crops are planted when the rains start: around March to April in the South and May to June in the North. Dry-season crops like wheat, onion and irrigated tomato are planted from November. Pick a crop below for its exact months.

Grains & cereals

  • 🌽 Maizeplant March to June and August
  • 🌾 Riceplant May to July and January to February
  • 🌾 Sorghum (Guinea corn)plant May to July
  • 🌾 Pearl milletplant May to July
  • 🌾 Wheatplant November to December
  • 🌾 Acha (Fonio)plant May to July

Legumes & oilseeds

  • 🫘 Cowpea (Beans)plant July to September
  • 🥜 Groundnutplant May to July
  • 🫛 Soybeanplant June to July
  • 🥜 Bambara groundnutplant May to July
  • 🫛 Pigeon peaplant May to July
  • 🫘 African yam beanplant April to June
  • 🌼 Sesame (Beniseed)plant June to July
  • 🌻 Sunflowerplant July to August
  • 🌱 Castorplant June to July

Roots & tubers

  • 🍠 Cassavaplant March to June and September to October
  • 🍠 White yamplant February to April
  • 🍠 Water yamplant March to May
  • 🥔 Cocoyam (Taro)plant March to May
  • 🍠 Sweet potatoplant April to July
  • 🥔 Irish potatoplant April to May and October to November
  • 🌰 Tiger nutplant May to July
  • 🥔 Tannia (New cocoyam)plant March to May
  • 🍠 Three-leaved yam (Bitter yam)plant March to April

Fruit vegetables

  • 🍅 Tomatoplant March to April and September to November
  • 🌶️ Hot pepperplant March to April and September to October
  • 🫑 Sweet pepper (Tatashe)plant September to November
  • 🧅 Onionplant September to December
  • 🧄 Garlicplant October to November
  • 🫛 Okraplant March to August
  • 🍆 Garden eggplant March to May and September
  • 🥒 Cucumberplant March to April and September to November
  • 🍈 Egusi melonplant April to June
  • 🫛 Green beansplant September to November
  • 🥬 Cabbageplant September to November
  • 🥕 Carrotplant September to November
  • 🎃 Pumpkinplant April to June
  • 🥦 Cauliflowerplant September to October

Leafy vegetables

  • 🥬 Amaranth (Efo tete)plant March to October
  • 🌿 Celosia (Soko)plant March to September
  • 🍃 Fluted pumpkin (Ugu)plant March to May
  • 🌿 Jute mallow (Ewedu)plant April to July
  • 🌿 Waterleafplant March to June
  • 🌿 Bitter leafplant March to May
  • 🥗 Lettuceplant September to November
  • 🌿 Moringaplant April to July
  • 🌺 Roselle (Zobo)plant June to July
  • 🧅 Spring onionplant March to October

Fruits

  • 🍉 Watermelonplant October to January
  • 🍍 Pineappleplant March to May
  • 🍌 Plantainplant March to May
  • 🍌 Bananaplant March to May
  • 🍈 Pawpaw (Papaya)plant April to June
  • 🥭 Mangoplant June to July
  • 🍊 Sweet orangeplant June to July
  • 🍋 Lime & Lemonplant June to July
  • 🍐 Guavaplant June to July
  • 🫐 African pear (Ube)plant June to July
  • 🥑 Avocadoplant June to July
  • 🍑 African star appleplant June to July
  • 🟤 Velvet tamarind (Awin)plant June to July
  • 🟤 Tamarindplant June to July

Tree & cash crops

  • 🌰 Cashewplant June to July
  • 🥥 Coconutplant April to July
  • 🌴 Date palmplant June to August
  • 🍫 Cocoaplant April to June
  • 🌴 Oil palmplant April to July
  • 🌳 Rubberplant June to July
  • ☁️ Cottonplant June to July
  • 🎋 Sugarcaneplant March to May and November to December
  • 🌰 Kola nutplant June to July
  • 🌳 Shea treeplant June to July
  • 🌳 Locust bean (Iru)plant June to July
  • ☕ Coffee (Robusta)plant June to July
  • 🍵 Teaplant April to June
  • 🌳 Gum arabic (Acacia)plant July to August
  • 🌿 Kenafplant June to July
  • 🌰 Bitter kolaplant June to July
  • 🌳 Baobabplant June to July

Spices & herbs

  • 🌿 Scent leafplant March to May
  • 🫚 Gingerplant April to May
  • 🫚 Turmericplant April to May
  • 🌿 Uzizaplant March to May
  • 🌾 Lemongrassplant March to May
